summary: Added sglang:kv_cache_usage_perc as an unrounded KV-only Prometheus gauge computed as max(full-attention usage, SWA usage), explicitly excluding Mamba state-pool pressure; documented it and added adversarial pool-semantics plus live serving coverage.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-a6c4fe687d89/venv/bin/python -c 'from sglang.srt.observability.metrics_collector import SchedulerStats; assert hasattr(SchedulerStats(), "kv_cache_usage_perc"), "SchedulerStats does not expose KV-cache-only usage"'
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction on the recorded base: SchedulerStats had no KV-cache-only usage field. Raw output: reports/j-a6c4fe687d89/evidence/failing-before.log.

Five CPU regression/adversarial tests for plain attention, full- and SWA-dominant hybrid attention, Mamba exclusion, combined SWA+SSM, and preservation of unrounded usage. Raw output: reports/j-a6c4fe687d89/evidence/unit-tests.log.

A real source-checkout SGLang server on the assigned GPU performed prefill/decode and exposed the new metric during an active generation. kv_cache_usage_perc was 0.01171875 and independently matched full_token_usage for the plain-attention fixture; the legacy rounded token_usage was 0.01. Requests, response, scrape, logs, and cleanup metadata are retained under reports/j-a6c4fe687d89/evidence/server/.
Repository formatting, lint, syntax, secret, CI-registration, and related pre-commit checks passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2/HIP 7.2.26015 executed a real tiny-Llama prefill and decode workload. The live scrape and server execution log are reports/j-a6c4fe687d89/evidence/server/metrics.txt and server.log; run-metadata.json records the exact command and measured values.

remaining_limitations: The deterministic tiny random Llama validates serving transport, engine execution, and plain-attention metric wiring only; it does not establish model semantic accuracy.
No qualified hybrid SWA or hybrid Mamba model weights were available, so those pool semantics were validated with direct CPU PoolStats regression tests rather than end-to-end GPU model runs.
No C++ or FlyDSL source changed; native rebuild and compiler/ISA evidence were not applicable.
The probe's owned server process group required SIGKILL after the 30-second SIGTERM grace period; its descendants were reaped, and no GPU reset or node-wide state change was performed.
